name: footer-watermark
title: Footer watermark
description: Dot-rendered Context.dev wordmark with pointer interaction and an animated cursor.
usage: The dark band at the very bottom of the site footer, filling it. Pass `outlined` and `solid` for another wordmark; mark a button beside it with the cursor origin attribute for the cursor.
avoid: The watermark on a light background
A watermark anywhere but the footer
